title: Fields
description: Customize the fields of each record type: names, types, rules, options and order.

list.label: {{recordType}} fields
list.emptyDescription: Create the first field to start customizing this record type.
list.allInactiveDescription: Check “Show inactive fields” to see them and activate them again.
list.unavailableDescription: This record type is not available in this organization yet. Its fields can be configured once it is enabled.

reorder.instructions: To reorder, press space or Enter to pick up the item, use the arrow keys to move it and press space or Enter again to drop it. Escape cancels.
reorder.cancelled: Reordering cancelled. {{label}} returned to its original position.

editor.description: Define how the field looks and which values it accepts.
editor.label: Name
editor.keyHint: Identifier used in filters, imports and the API. Lowercase letters, digits and _. It cannot be changed later.
editor.typeHint: The type can only change to a compatible one: text, email, link and phone among themselves, or number and currency.
editor.typeLocked: The type of this field cannot be changed.
editor.systemNotice: This is a system field: only its name can be changed.
editor.requiredHint: Records can only be saved with this field filled in.
editor.uniqueHint: Two records cannot share the same value in this field.
editor.searchableHint: The value is included in the quick record search.
editor.systemPrivacyNotice: This is a system field: only its name and privacy classification can be changed.
editor.personalHint: Identifies or may identify a person (name, email, phone, document). Included in data subject search, export and anonymization.
editor.sensitiveHint: Racial or ethnic origin, health, religion, political opinion, biometrics and similar (LGPD art. 5, II). Sensitive data is always personal too.

config.decimalsHint: From 0 to 6. Currencies use 2 when empty.
config.currencyHint: 3-letter ISO code, such as BRL or USD. Empty uses the organization currency.
config.patternHint: Optional. Values must match this pattern, for example ^[0-9]{11}$.
config.defaultCountryHint: 2-letter ISO code used for numbers without a country code. Empty uses BR.
config.defaultValueHint: Filled in automatically on new records.
config.noOptions: Add options to choose a default value.

options.title: Options
options.description: Drag to set the order in which options appear.
options.label: Option {{position}} name
options.inactiveHint: Inactive options can no longer be chosen, but records that already use them keep the value.

confirmDeactivate.title: Deactivate the {{label}} field?
confirmDeactivate.description: The field stops showing in forms, filters and lists. Values already filled in are kept and come back if you activate the field again.

validation.label: Use between 1 and 140 characters.
validation.key: Use up to 64 lowercase letters, digits or _, starting with a letter, without __ and without a trailing _.
validation.unique: This field type does not support unique values.
validation.searchable: This field type cannot be searchable.
validation.number: Enter a number, such as 10 or 10.5.
validation.minMax: The maximum value must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
validation.decimals: Use a whole number from 0 to 6.
validation.currency: Use a 3-letter code, such as BRL.
validation.maxLength: Use a whole number within the type limit.
validation.maxLengthText: Use a whole number from 1 to 1024.
validation.maxLengthLongText: Use a whole number from 1 to 65535.
validation.pattern: Enter a valid regular expression with up to 500 characters.
validation.country: Use a 2-letter code, such as BR.
validation.defaultValue: The default value does not satisfy the rules of this field.
validation.defaultOutOfRange: The default value must be between the minimum and the maximum.
validation.defaultDecimals: The default value has more decimal places than allowed.
validation.defaultTooLong: The default value is longer than the maximum length.
validation.defaultPattern: The default value does not match the pattern.
validation.datetime: Enter a valid date and time.
validation.url: Enter a valid link, such as https://example.com.
validation.optionValue: An option with this name already exists.
validation.color: Use a hex color, such as #1f6feb.
validation.formulaResultType: Choose a result type compatible with the expression.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Try again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.invalid: Some data is invalid. Review it and try again.
errors.fieldNotFound: The field was not found. Refresh the page.
errors.optionNotFound: The option was not found. Refresh the page.
errors.recordTypeNotFound: This record type is not available yet.
errors.fieldKeyTaken: A field with this key already exists.
errors.optionValueTaken: An option with this name already exists.
errors.systemFieldLocked: Only the name of system fields can be changed, and they cannot be deactivated.
errors.incompatibleFieldType: The type can only change to a compatible one.
errors.duplicateValues: Some records repeat values in this field. Fix them before making it unique.
errors.tooManyFields: This record type already reached the limit of 200 custom fields.
errors.versionConflict: This record was changed by someone else since you opened it. Reload the page and apply your change again.
errors.formulaCycle: The formula creates a circular dependency between fields.
